specs_json.battery: DB1560 Intelligent Flight Battery, 30000 mAh, 52.22 V, ~12.1 kg
specs_json.charge_time: ~9-12 min fast charge with D12000iE generator

notes: Flagship global ag drone; coaxial twin-rotor x4 layout for heavy lift. Spray and spread systems swappable. Phased-array radar enables terrain follow and obstacle bypass over crops.

failure_modes.name: Nozzle/pump clogging
failure_modes.mitigation: flush tank and lines with clean water after every session; strain chemicals; replace atomizer discs on schedule

failure_modes.name: Battery swelling / capacity fade from fast-charge heat
failure_modes.mitigation: allow cool-down between cycles, use active-cooling charging station, retire packs below 80% health

failure_modes.name: Chemical corrosion of connectors and frame
failure_modes.mitigation: rinse airframe post-flight, dielectric grease on connectors, periodic teardown inspection

failure_modes.name: Phased-array radar false negatives on thin obstacles
failure_modes.mitigation: pre-map field obstacles, maintain manual line-of-sight supervision, fly conservative margins near wires

failure_modes.name: Motor/ESC failure under max gross weight in heat
failure_modes.mitigation: derate payload at high density altitude and >40°C, clean motor cooling paths, log and trend ESC temps

failure_modes.name: RTK/GNSS degradation causing swath overlap errors
failure_modes.mitigation: use D-RTK 2 base station, check antenna mounts, pause ops during ionospheric disturbance
